مَوْهُوب A thing given; properly, as a free gift, &c.: see the verb. (Msb.) ―
-b2- مَوْهُوبٌ لَهُ Having a thing given to him; properly, as a free gift, &c. (Msb.) ―
-b3- مَوْهُوبٌ A son; a child; offspring: and whatever is given to one by the Liberal, or Bountiful, Giver, i. e., by God. An epithet in which the character of a subst. is predominant. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
